items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: James Brown has always been my childhood hero, and it would be the dream of a lifetime to record with James Brown.

ctx.x: We are filming this evening for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a great pleasure to have Christian McBride join us, and for a hot set at the Sarasota Jazz Festival. I’m going to make a guess from listening to your answer machine a couple of times trying to reach you, that jazz was not your only influence when you were growing up.
That’s exactly right. You are referring to the scream you hear when my answer machine picks up, the scream of James Brown. Everyone seems to get awakened by that.
The first time I heard it.
